title: Line-Touch Interval Sprints
description: Players sprint to touch each line on the court in a fixed sequence with timed rest intervals, a simple, equipment-free conditioning staple.

content.objective: Build conditioning through simple, measurable sprint intervals with controlled rest.
content.setup: Players line up on the baseline with a timer set for repeated intervals.
instructions: On the whistle, sprint to touch the free-throw line and return to the baseline.
Rest for a fixed interval (for example, 20 seconds).
Sprint to touch half court and return to the baseline.
Repeat the sequence for the planned number of rounds, resting the same interval each time.
coachingPoints: Sprint at full effort on every rep, not just the first one.
Use the rest interval fully to recover, not to chat or wander.
Touch each line clearly rather than cutting the turn early.
commonMistakes: Pacing conservatively instead of sprinting at genuine effort.
Cutting the rest interval short or extending it inconsistently.
Pacing too conservatively instead of working at real effort.
content.safety: Make sure the court is clear and dry before beginning the intervals.
